name: Kunszentmárton (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light blue at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kunszentmárton: a crowned blue shield with Saint Martin on horseback, with red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kunszentmárton arms with crown and mantling
